items.title: Gatchaman, Battle of the Planets, G-Force, Eagle Riders
items.description:
Rips of a bunch of versions of Gatchaman.

Including DVD rips of the Kid Rhino Battle of the Planets Volume 1-6. Each volume has two episodes of Battle of the Planets, two episodes of subtitled Gatchaman, and one episode of G-Force.

Also includes DVD ri
